name: NetHack Learning Environment (NLE) / MiniHack
description: The NetHack Learning Environment (NLE) wraps the classic roguelike dungeon crawler NetHack, featuring procedural level generation, 500+ monster and item types, complex mechanics including spells, hunger, traps, and persistent state with long-term dependencies. MiniHack is a sandbox framework built on the NetHack engine for rapidly creating targeted custom open-ended tasks, from tiny rooms to full procedural dungeons. Together they benchmark open-ended RL, exploration, memory, and skill transfer at varying difficulty scales.
general_score_metric: in-game score; dungeon level reached; task_completion (MiniHack)
typical_sota_score: Top RL agents reach ~2000-5000 score (human expert: ~5000+); full game remains largely unsolved
reputation: Famously difficult for both humans and AI; gold-standard for open-ended RL and exploration research; MiniHack enables reproducible targeted experiments; widely used for LLM agent evaluation.
notes: NetHack's procedural generation + 500+ item/monster interactions create effectively unbounded complexity. Symbolic (ASCII) and pixel observation modes available. LLM/text-based agents widely used via symbolic observations. MiniHack enables targeted difficulty control while preserving full engine expressiveness.
